timeline_convention: Controls are sanitized and accepted only when a persistent 16-frame source quantum begins. Accepted page and LaneControlMode determine mapping and surface context but do not enter audio equations. A ControllerAdapter zero-to-positive edge is classified before Controls publication; duplicate positive values and releases do not dispatch. Trigger Enable is exact zero or one before scheduler evaluation. The existing seven voices, scheduler, source RNG virtualization, dry/cohesion/final path, and outer-block carry retain revision 0.4 timing.

tolerances.context_noninterference: mode-only changes alter only accepted LaneControlMode, accepted sequence, surface descriptors, and provenance; PCM and every musical/scheduler/source/effect field remain exact
tolerances.controller_partition_artifacts: byte exact within one frozen build for 1, 16, 64, 128, 257, and 512 frame hosts
tolerances.non_target_equality: all six non-selected lane/voice records and all global/effect records are exact for a selected-lane edit
tolerances.semantic_field_coverage: exactly 8 Voice, 8 Motion, 8 Sequencer, 8 cohesion, BPM, and Master fields are reachable with no duplicate target within a context
tolerances.trigger_off: CC0 and CC63 accept exact zero and from fresh reset produce zero trigger count, zero started mask, and exact-zero PCM
tolerances.trigger_on: CC64 and CC127 accept exact one and produce byte-identical PCM, events, accepted musical state, and source RNG state except raw-input provenance
tolerances.voice_motion_switch: same-lane first positive edge toggles exactly once; duplicate positive and release do not; another-lane selection preserves mode
